challenge.method: Read the complete scope clause and tested whether its program-language identity could instead identify a compiler, confer a support status, or promise operating-environment portability.
challenge.results: The first sentence explicitly identifies programs in Ada. The portability statement gives a purpose. The paragraph supplies no implementation or deployment classification, and the candidate explicitly attributes the active classification to the Language Index.

limitations: The manual establishes the language identity in this edition. Active status is the index classification.
